nieuw.titel: Consider Giant Rats for redirecting charges
nieuw.tekst: He considers Giant Rats one of the best units for redirecting enemy charges.
nieuw.waarom: He demonstrates how an 18-inch march lets a 30-point unit reach a blocking position and buy another round of shooting.
nieuw.voorbeeld: He kept Giant Rats behind impassable terrain in marching column, then moved them in front of a Bretonnian character to protect a Warp Lightning Cannon.

bronnen.citaat: I think Skaven have maybe one of the best units

nieuw.titel: Hold with the redirector when fleeing exposes your protected unit
nieuw.tekst: Let the enemy charge and kill your redirector when fleeing would let it redirect into the unit you are protecting. Keep the redirector's facing aligned so the enemy cannot overrun into that protected unit.
nieuw.waarom: He explains that fleeing would have given the enemy character an opportunity to redirect into his Warp Lightning Cannon.
nieuw.voorbeeld: His Giant Rats held against a Bretonnian character, died and left the character needing to restrain and reform. That bought another shooting round, in which two Warp Lightning Cannons killed it.
nieuw.wanneerNiet: He says this screen would not have worked against a dragon, because it could see over the Giant Rats as a Large Target.

bronnen.citaat: You don't want to flee with these guys.

extraCitaten.citaat: but that would give him the opportunity to redirect into my warp lightning cannon.

nieuw.titel: Allow for panic when sacrificing Giant Rats
nieuw.tekst: Keep sacrificial Giant Rats six inches away from your other units, or be prepared to take a panic test when they are destroyed.
nieuw.waarom: He warns that Giant Rats cause panic in nearby friendly units when destroyed in combat.

bronnen.citaat: So, you need to be that 6 in away

extraCitaten.citaat: or just be prepared to roll a panic test

nieuw.titel: Keep a Screaming Bell behind your Stormvermin
nieuw.tekst: Put your general, a Grey Seer on a Screaming Bell, in a large Clanrat unit behind the Stormvermin. Use this central support piece to provide Leadership 10, bell buffs and spellcasting while the Stormvermin fight ahead.
nieuw.waarom: He values keeping a substantial investment behind other troops while it still contributes without needing to enter combat.
nieuw.voorbeeld: His bell granted an extra attack within command range, stacking with Skaven brew on the Stormvermin. They broke through Knights of the Realm on Foot and ran them down.

bronnen.citaat: rats behind it with the screaming bell in the clan rats.

nieuw.titel: Consider a Griffon General for defensive central support
nieuw.tekst: Consider using a General of the Empire on a Griffon as a defensive support piece in the centre. Use his Leadership 10 while shooting weakens enemies, then fly out to charge weakened targets.
nieuw.waarom: He points to the General's 18-inch leadership bubble as a way to give the centre more durability.

bronnen.citaat: I think he's a defensive supportive piece.
